# CharacterCapsule

A kinematic character capsule for a [SkinnedMesh](SkinnedMesh.md), in world
units (after the mesh's `scale`).

## Parameters

- `half_height`: A float. Half-height of the capsule's cylindrical section. Defaults to `0.5`.
- `radius`: A float. Capsule radius. Defaults to `0.3`.
